fact: Citing BEAC data, Ecomatin reports that Equatorial Guinea's banking rate was about 27% in 2023, and that BEAC's 2024 payment services report counts only 50,224 mobile money accounts, the lowest in the CEMAC; this is administrative data, not an adult survey.
title: Paiement mobile : au bas du classement en zone Cemac, la Guinée équatoriale relance le projet 'Getesa Money'
